Maria G.: Heads-up — we need to finalize the handoff for private/VPC metrics export agent + dashboards this week. Targeting Dedicated rollout next Tue. Main blockers: firewall egress rules, KMS audit hooks, metrics schema for dashboards, and quota/routing defaults. Can infra/security/runtime/product sync on concrete requirements?

Ash (Infra): +1. Packet filter + proxy rules we need: allow outbound to metrics-collector.redwood.io:443 and s3 upload endpoint for customer buckets. Also need to decide if agent should use a pull vs push handshake to our collector (push preferred for NAT'ed onprem).

Kevin P.: For dashboards we need two new timeseries: export_handshake_success_rate and export_enqueue_latency. Also expose per-agent version and tenant_id as labels. Can we standardize label names? Suggest labels: tenant_id, agent_version, region, export_mode (push|pull).

Sophie S.: Security: KMS integration constraints — customers may want to use their CMK; must support both: customer-managed KMS (via external key ARN) and Redwood-managed keys. Customer CMK flow triggers extra audit-log entries and requires proof-of-possession during handshake. Also we need an audit hook to export key-usage events to the tenant's audit S3 path.

Jenny R.: Runtime note: current agent 0.9.x supports mTLS and signed JWT. If we add CMK flow we should avoid extra roundtrips. Proposal: agent uploads encrypted envelope to s3 and sends metadata to collector with signed JWT referencing s3 path. Example config snippet we plan to add to agent.conf:

```
export_mode = "push"
collector = "https://metrics-collector.redwood.io"
kms_mode = "customer" # or "redwood"
cmk_arn = "arn:aws:kms:..."
upload_bucket = "s3://tenant-a-redwood-audit"
```

Ash (Infra): That aligns with egress policies. Firewall team: allow TLS outbound to collector + S3 endpoints. For customers behind strict egress, we should document proxy env var support (HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY).

Sophie S.: Audit logs must be tamper-evident. We should add a step where agent writes an immutable audit entry to the customer's S3 path, then we index a digest in our audit service. That digest should be KMS-signed when using Redwood KMS and HMAC-signed when customer KMS is used (to avoid needing decryption).

Kevin P.: On dashboards + quotas: product wants a per-tenant quota default (daily export token limit) plus an adaptive routing policy that falls back to hosted ingestion when the private export queue is >90% full. Need signals: queue_fill_pct, last_handshake_age, last_successful_export_ts. Dashboards should include a small rollout UX panel: canary percent, active_tenants_in_canary, error_rate_change_pct.

Maria G.: UX/rollout ask: product wants a one-click toggle in Console to add a tenant to canary and to set the fallback policy (strict|allow-hosted|hybrid). That needs an API change. Kevin, what's the smallest schema change to support that?

Kevin P.: Add tenant.metadata -> rolloutPolicy with fields: mode, canary_percent. Keep names minimal to avoid telemetry churn. We'll version as rollout_v2. Agent shouldn't need to change for read-only toggles; controller will signal routing.

Jenny R.: Agent patch minimal: expose agent_version and support a dynamic route label from controller (we already read env var ROUTE_MODE). Rolling update plan: canary 5% for 2h, then 25% for 4h, then 100% if error rate < 0.5%. Need tracing hooks in agent to tag requests with canary=true for sampling.

Ash (Infra): Firewall ops: we also need to publish a concise doc with CIDR list for collector + S3 endpoints and recommended proxy config. I'll draft it and ping netops.

Sophie S.: Final security checklist from my side: mTLS validation + JWT expiry <= 5m, KMS key rotation policy documented, S3 bucket ACLs enforced, and audit digest retention >= 90 days. If any customer requires longer, escalate to compliance.

Maria G.: OK — action items: Ash: CIDR doc + proxy guide (due EOD Thu). Sophie: finalize KMS/audit hook contract + signing scheme (due Fri AM). Kevin: telemetry schema PR with labels + rolloutPolicy minimal change (due Thu). Jenny: agent config sample + small tracing hook PR (due Fri). I'll coordinate console API change with product. Anyone else? @deploy-bot, we'll need a deploy window scheduled for next Tue morning. :calendar:
